    Short preexact sequences and direct sums #

    Triviality of morphisms and short preexact sequences are compatible with binary direct sums and transport along isomorphisms. Together with the decomposition of an object into indecomposables, this reduces the verification of the pretorsion-theory axioms to indecomposable objects.

    CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.Limits.biprod.map f₁ f₂) (CategoryTheory.Limits.biprod.map g₁ g₂) = CategoryTheory.Limits.biprod.map (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f₁ g₁) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f₂ g₂)
